Android 12 changed how back press in the root activity functions
To see the new behavior, press back or swipe to leave the app. Then, reopen the app.
You will not see the splash screen and the state will be restored. This is because the activity was not finished actually, only hidden. Exactly like if you just switch to another app.
Also, check the logs. They should show that onDestroy method was not called
To see old behavior, press back or swipe to leave the app. Then, reopen the app.
If you reopen an app from the launcher, you will see that app is fully rebooted. Splash screen is shown again and the state is not restored.
In the logs, you can see that onDestroy method was called
If you reopen an app from recents menu, instance state should be restored. You can also find this in the logs.

Starting with Android 12, when an app accesses microphone or camera, an icon appears in the status bar. Also, in Quick Access menu, there should be a toggle that immediately turns off microphone or camera for all apps currently running on the device. Handy if you don\'t know which app accesses them.
